Here is a 3x3x3 Rubik's cube.

Colour scheme: the centre sticker of each face fixes its colour and never moves: U (up) = white W, D (down) = yellow Y, F (front) = green G, B (back) = blue B, R (right) = red R, L (left) = orange O.
Moves: U, D, R, L, F, B each turn that face 90 degrees clockwise as seen looking directly at that face; X' is the 90 degree counterclockwise turn and X2 the 180 degree turn.
The allowed moves are exactly: U U' U2 D D' D2 R R' R2 L L' L2 F F' F2 B B' B2 (no whole-cube rotations).

Net (each face seen from outside):
          U
        B O G
        W W B
        O R G
  L       F       R       B
R G W   B B O   Y W Y   R Y W
B O G   O G W   O R R   Y B Y
Y R G   W G O   W G B   Y B O
          D
        R R G
        W Y Y
        B O R
Facelet string (colour letters; faces in the order U R F D L B, 9 stickers each, read row by row as in the net):
BOGWWBORGYWYORRWGBBBOOGWWGORRGWYYBORRGWBOGYRGRYWYBYYBO

A move is correct if it is the first move of a shortest possible solution. Each of the 18 allowed moves counts as one move, so a 180 degree turn counts as one. Give one correct move, written exactly as it appears in the list of allowed moves. Answer with `MOVE: <move>`.
